title: UI风格#115 - Bauhaus Color Block (包豪斯色块)
description: 创建第115种UI风格：包豪斯色块风格 - 几何色块、红黄蓝、现代主义。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDK.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Color Block style When color palette Then features primary red, yellow, blue with black and white
Given Bauhaus Color Block style When typography Then uses geometric sans: Futura, Universal, or Gotham
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Futura (几何), Universal (正文), Gotham (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Color Block style When layout Then color block grid, overlapping shapes, asymmetric balance, bold divisions
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：色块网格、重叠形状、非对称平衡、大胆分割

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Color Block style When UI elements Then flat color, hard edges, geometric precision
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：纯色平面、硬边、几何精度、块状动画

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Color Block UI When functional Then includes block chat, grid agents, primary stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：色块聊天、网格代理、原色统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Color Block UI When copy Then uses modernist: 'Block', 'Grid', 'Primary', 'Form'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'BLOCK. GRID. PRIMARY.'、按钮'SEND'→'SHAPE'、'SUBMIT'→'BALANCE'
